question: On the consumed tenth family, can calibrated depth and camera pose generate one missing-frame proposal from the adjacent frame's highest contributor-agreement box, without changing the three-slot bound?

predecessor.single_change: Replace ranking-only temporal vacancy insertion with one physically generated rectangle: select the adjacent query candidate supported by the most preserved mechanisms, estimate its median metric depth, and reproject its four corners through official camera poses into the other frame.

hypothesis_generation.anchor_selection: Across both adjacent queries, select the exact-deduplicated candidate supported by the greatest number of preserved contributors; tie by higher frozen semantic/local fusion, then earlier query order.
hypothesis_generation.vacancy_rule: Append the propagated rectangle only to the non-anchor query when exact deduplication leaves fewer than three hypotheses.

geometry.depth_selection: Backproject all valid anchor-frame depth pixels through the official depth intrinsic, project them into color coordinates, retain those inside the frozen anchor rectangle, and use their median metric depth.
geometry.rectangle_propagation: Backproject the four anchor rectangle corners through the official color intrinsic at the median depth, transform camera-to-world with the anchor pose and world-to-camera with the target pose inverse, project into the target color frame, take the four-corner min/max rectangle, and clip to image bounds.

literature_motivation.source: Seeing Behind Objects for 3D Multi-Object Tracking in RGB-D Sequences
literature_motivation.use: Motivates backprojecting RGB-D observations and using 3D geometry and correspondences to persist object evidence across changing views.

forbidden_after_freeze: change the consumed family, images, candidate roster, preserved contributors, anchor rule, depth statistic, intrinsics, pose convention, corner propagation, clipping, set size or IoU gate
add padding, percentile tuning, optical flow, truth-guided anchor selection or truth-guided geometry
reinterpret a positive consumed-family Development result as fresh transfer
claim_boundary: This posthoc run is failure-driven Development on the already consumed tenth family. A positive result can establish only a physically plausible proposal-reachability mechanism under official RGB-D calibration and pose; it is not fresh confirmation, RGB-only or phone transfer, top-one localization, calibrated uncertainty, portal ownership, affordance, access, safety, waypoint, arrival or handoff.
